properties.rationale: Standing acknowledgement, unchanged in substance and re-stated because the rollup's id moves whenever the capability set does: validation for this project is the trials programme — reflow2 being used on real designs (this repo, storyflow, the fleet) — not a validation-kind Verification per capability. Recording 60 near-identical validation nodes would be ceremony that makes the number go green without anyone having checked anything, which is exactly the dishonesty `dec:passing-is-verified` exists to prevent.
